method: Pinned existing Ghidra exports, direct instruction checks and host Unicorn. No fresh REA/Ghidra session, camera connection, camera execution, device writes or patch.

cases.name: configured_video_time_sequence
cases.does_not_include: Encoder, mux file output, FIFO operations or real camera timing

host_emulation.limitation: Constructed inputs; real movie init/helpers execute, while getter and origin/resume prefixes stop at explicit boundaries. No real encoder, mux file or pause/resume lifecycle is run.

field_writers.video_track_40: InitMovieInfo copies cfg+20; primary open cfg+20 and cfg+04 both come from selected sensor row+10.
field_writers.video_track_58: InitPTS clears; ProcessVideo stores first descriptor PTS when origin==0 and frame_count_48==0; ResumePipe clears again.
field_writers.video_track_68: InitPTS uses -low32(period*(count78-1)) if control7e==0; ResumePipe adds saved_DTS-current_DTS modulo 2^64.
field_writers.video_track_78: InitMovieInfo copies cfg+28; primary open gets count from sensor metadata row+04, all 88 pinned rows hold 1.
field_writers.video_track_7d: InitMovieInfo copies cfg+2d; primary/event open explicitly set 0 in inspected path.
field_writers.video_track_7e: InitMovieInfo copies cfg+2e, zeroed by GetDefaultMovieInfoCfg in inspected open path; ResumePipe resets zero.
